title: Closed complementary subtopoi: factorization and supported module sheaves
statement:
Let $\mathcal T$ be a Grothendieck topos (sheaves of sets on a small site in [def-weil-size-convention]), let $U\hookrightarrow1_{\mathcal T}$ be a subterminal object (a monomorphism to the terminal object), and let $j:\mathcal T/U\to\mathcal T$ be its open slice topos. The full subcategory of objects $H$ for which $U\times H\to U$ is an isomorphism is a topos $\mathcal Z$, with a geometric embedding $i:\mathcal Z\to\mathcal T$ whose direct image is this inclusion. This is the closed subtopos complementary to $U$. For every Grothendieck topos $\mathcal E$, composition with $i$ identifies morphisms $\mathcal E\to\mathcal Z$ with morphisms $a:\mathcal E\to\mathcal T$ such that $a^{-1}U$ is initial, including their $2$-morphisms (natural transformations between direct-image functors as in [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]). In particular, the inverse image of this closed subtopos under $a$ is the closed complement of $a^{-1}U$.

Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring and use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over the constant ring sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Write $i^*$ for inverse image on these modules, with its adjunction $i^*\dashv i_*$. The functor $i_*$ on these modules is exact and fully faithful, its adjunction counit $i^*i_*\to1$ is an isomorphism, and its essential image consists exactly of modules $M$ with $j^*M=0$. Equivalently, for such $M$ the actual adjunction unit $M\to i_*i^*M$ is an isomorphism.

For any closed immersion of schemes $k:F\hookrightarrow S$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], its geometric morphism on small etale topoi [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] identifies $F_{\mathrm{Et}}$ with this closed complement in $S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ for the subterminal sheaf represented by $S\setminus F$.

The scheme example is etale-cohomology.tex Tag 04CA (proposition-closed-immersion-pushforward)(1). The factorization characterization is the universal-property form of the closed complement, recorded as an agent formulation of this construction.

proof.text: Apply lem-trf-topos-complement-factorization to obtain the closed and open topoi and the inclusion geometric morphisms. Transport the closed factorization criterion between embeddings whose direct images identify with the same full-subcategory inclusion. Left exact inverse image preserves subterminal objects, as seen by applying it to the diagonal and the product comparison. Apply the complement construction again to a^{-1}U. Its inclusion k sends a^{-1}U to an initial object, so k followed by a factors through the original closed complement. The two factorization criteria identify the required inverse-image universal property. Full faithfulness of each inclusion gives the asserted bijections on natural transformations by right whiskering.

source.place: Tags 08LY, 08LZ and 08M0: construction and universal property of the closed complementary subtopos.

proof.text: Use the unit compatibility equations in the normalized constant-module inverse-image lift. The conservative forgetful functors from module sheaves to abelian sheaves and then set sheaves show that a module adjunction unit is invertible exactly when the actual set-sheaf adjunction unit is invertible. For the fully faithful closed set direct image, Mathlib identifies this with membership in its essential image. On the open slice, terminality of Over.star U applied to H is equivalent to invertibility of U times H to U. The lift comparison and reflection of terminal objects identify this with vanishing of the open module inverse image. Thus the module unit is invertible exactly on supported modules. The module direct image reflects isomorphisms, since its underlying set functor is the fully faithful set direct image composed with a conservative forgetful functor. Its objects are supported, and the triangle identity now shows the actual module counit is invertible. This proves module full faithfulness and the essential-image characterization. Limits are preserved by the right adjoint. For any finite diagram in the closed module category, its ambient direct-image colimit has zero open restriction, since open module inverse image preserves finite colimits and the whole diagram restricts to zero. The essential-image criterion places this colimit in the closed image; the fully faithful functor creates this colimit and hence preserves it.

source.place: Tag 08M3, lemma-i-star-equivalence, together with Tags 03DI, 0710 and 04EQ for the module adjunction and support description.

proof.text: The small etale topology is subcanonical, so sheafification of the lifted representable of the complementary open is canonically isomorphic to the represented sheaf. The open immersion is a monomorphism, making that sheaf subterminal. Evaluate the product projection on each etale object V: it is invertible exactly when every section of the represented open over V forces H(V) to be a singleton. Open restriction is precomposition with the etale-site composition functor, identified with the actual inverse image using its adjunction and uniqueness of left adjoints. Every etale object over the open has a section of the represented open after composition, and conversely any etale V with such a section is canonically the composition of an etale object over the open, using etale cancellation. Consequently the singleton-section condition is precisely terminality of open restriction. Apply lem-trf-etale-closed-complement-sets: its fully faithful scheme direct image has this exact essential image. Lift it to the full subcategory of closed-complement objects; the lift is fully faithful and essentially surjective, giving the desired equivalence whose composite with inclusion is the original direct image.
